# Plan

Related:

## Body

E4 — an active document with one eligible candidate and one edge pointing
INTO the archive subtree. The archived neighbour must be excluded and named
ineligible (`already-archived`); in 1.x a cascade relocated it to
`archive/<today>/old.md` and rewrote its `Updated:` field, which is history
rewriting, not over-reach. This shape is load-bearing on real trees, where a
status tracker accumulates archive-subtree edges.
